editorial.blurb: Saigon Sisters brings authentic Vietnamese and Thai cuisine to Chicago with attentive service, elevated dishes, and a warm, refined atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the lemongrass pork plate with the vegetable salad and ask about seasonal specials like the whole fish branzino—the chef takes care in sourcing and preparation.
signatureDishes: Shrimp spring rolls with peanut dipping sauce
